title: The EmDash MCP warm-up calls schema_list_collections (read-only, no argument), so it warms the road instead of failing input validation on every agent open
steps: S1: Create an agent on an EmDash site whose browser said hello, with an exec that records its input.
S2: Read the tool's definition in the pinned EmDash tree (vendor/emdash/emdash/packages/core/src/mcp/server.ts).
expect: S1: one exec whose stdin is tools/call schema_list_collections with empty arguments.
S2: that tool's inputSchema is z.object({}) and it carries readOnlyHint: true.
evidence: Stand acceptance 16/10/2026 (deschaarem1610): every EmDash agent open logged 'pre-warm of the MCP road ... did not finish: emdash TOOL_FAILED'; content_list without collection answers 'Invalid arguments ... expected string, received undefined at collection'. schema_list_collections on the same site answered 200 in 1.5 s
fence: The warm-up stays one read-only call with no argument; it never names a collection a site may not have

tests: an EmDash agent also warms the site's MCP road
the MCP warm-up calls an EmDash tool whose input needs no argument
